latest_release.name: Lumeed QScan 1.9.0
latest_release.changelog:
## What's new in 1.9.0

### New: "Document date in filename" setting (Settings tab)

Untick it and output names drop the date prefix:

- Before: `2021010047_003_CLARK DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION.pdf`
- After: `0047_003_CLARK DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION.pdf`

The pattern and example in the Output Structure & Filename Format card update live as you toggle it.

### Faster processing when the date is off

The date scan (date candidates, control-anchor search, routing-slip date, confidence scoring, early exit) is skipped. Blank-page detection and the OCR text used for company matching still run, so blank removal and company accuracy are unchanged.

### Review changes

- The document date corrector (Date / month / year) is hidden in the Review tab while the setting is off — Company, OK, OCR and CONFIRM ALL stay.
- Auto-confirm now uses company confidence + QC only; documents with weak company names still go to Review.
- Rename-from-Reviewed accepts both filename formats and rebuilds in the selected one, so legacy dated files can be converted to dateless names.

### Defaults

The shipped defaults now match the reference configuration — fresh installs start with the Document date setting **off**. Flip the tickbox on any time to return to `YYYYMM####_###_COMPANY.pdf`.

### Fixes

- Flat-folder sequence numbering now counts dateless names (no more restarting at 0001).
- Undated confirmed documents are written to `passed_index.json`.
- A dateless filename is never misread as a date in the Reviewed list.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Raymond0627/Automated-System/compare/v1.8.4...v1.9.0

releases.name: Lumeed QScan 1.8.4
releases.changelog:
## Lumeed QScan 1.8.4

### New features
- **Organize Pages** - open two documents from the same Review tab side by side and drag/reorder pages between them, with a single in-dialog Undo and direct file save on the Reviewed tab.
- **Merge with...** - right-click a document, pick another, and merge its pages into the first (the right-clicked document keeps its name).
- **Multi-source company resolver** - resolves company names from letterheads, signatures, a roster gazetteer, and folder hints (not just case captions), with a configurable "Company Confidence" gate in Settings.
- **Automatic roster learning** - confirming a document now auto-adds the company to the roster and remembers folder/letterhead hints.

### Fixes
- Fixed a crash when dragging pages in the Organize window.
- The Reviewed date corrector now shows month abbreviations (01 Jan, 02 Feb, ...).

### Downloads
- `LumeedQScan_Setup_1.8.4.exe`: Windows installer with embedded Tesseract OCR.

## Lumeed QScan 1.8.3

### Improvements & Updates
- **Real-time Reviewed Counter:** Number on the Reviewed tab now updates immediately upon hitting Enter, OK, or Confirm All.
- **Background Output Scan:** Output directory is automatically scanned in the background on launch and after scan runs.
- **Streamlined Processing:** Removed flagged folder staging and disabled rename_log.csv generation.
- **Updated Default Configuration:** Bundled full 348-company roster and preconfigured default settings (flat layout, division 155, 2 worker threads).

### Downloads
- LumeedQScan_Setup_1.8.3.exe: Windows installer with embedded Tesseract OCR and preconfigured defaults.

releases.name: Lumeed Document Inventory v1.2.6
releases.changelog:
## Lumeed Document Inventory v1.2.6

Adds a **Folder Number** column to the Box Count tab and better tracking of files with no box.

### New: Folder Number column (Box Count)
- New column right after **Box Number**: **Folder Number**.
- A folder number is a folder named digits-with-a-dot, e.g. `013.01.03`. They are collected at any depth under a box; the same box number across different parents shows the **union** (deduped, sorted).
- The cell is a **clickable chip**: collapsed it shows the first number + a `+N` hint; **click to expand** a popup with the full list; **click again to close**; opening another cell closes the previous one. The row height never grows.

### "No box" tracking
- The **No box** row lists where the unboxed PDFs live:
  - If the folder **is a folder number** → shows the number with its file count, e.g. `033.02.04 (31)` (identical numbers merge).
  - Otherwise → shows the **relative folder path** with its count, e.g. `BACKUP10\PHIL AXA LIFE INSURANCE CORP_6 (4)`.

### Excel export
- New **Folder Numbers** column. Multiple entries appear on **separate lines inside the same cell** (one per line), e.g.:
  ```
  013.01.03
  013.01.04
  ```
- The "No box" row lists each source `033.02.04 (31)` on its own line. Totals row still sums files and pages.

### Also included since v1.2.5 (rebuilt)
- Box Count tab with per-box **Total PDF Files** and **Total Pages** and styled Excel export.
- Configurable duplicate matching (File name / Page count / File size checkboxes).
- Redesigned UI: resizable folder pane, 5 colored summary cards, header/path bar, breadcrumb, tab icons; app renamed to **Lumeed Document Inventory**.
- One-time migration so **all summary cards show by default**; **theme change no longer wipes other settings**.
- Faster scans (parallel readers + page-count cache); working Cancel; crash-safe path copy.

### Install
Download **`Lumeed-Pcount-Setup-1.2.6-x64.exe`** below and run it. Running it over an older install upgrades in place — no need to uninstall first.

### Notes
- Requires Windows 10 version 1809 (x64) or later. Windows App Runtime 2.4 is bundled.
- Isolated duplicates (Settings → Isolate duplicates) can be reverted.

releases.name: Lumeed Document Inventory v1.2.5
releases.changelog:
## Lumeed Document Inventory v1.2.5

UI redesign, Box Count workflow, configurable duplicate matching, plus fixes.

### New: Box Count tab
- New **Box Count** tab reporting **per-box totals: Box Number | Total PDF Files | Total Pages**.
- Box folders are recognised by name (`box` + a number, case-insensitive, trailing text allowed) — `Box 145`, `box145`, `BOX-145b`, `Box 145 (2021)` all resolve to **Box 145**. Same number under different parents aggregates; nested boxes use the nearest.
- **Export to Excel…** produces a styled `.xlsx` (title, banded table, autofilter, frozen header, totals row).

### Configurable duplicate matching
- Settings → **Duplicates** has three independent checkboxes: **File name**, **Page count**, **File size**. Two PDFs count as duplicates when they match on **every checked** attribute (pick any 1, 2, or 3).

### Redesigned interface
- **Resizable folder pane** — hold and drag the splitter left/right.
- **Responsive 5-card dashboard** — Total Pages, Total Files, Duplicate Files, Duplicate Pages, Unique Pages, each with a colour-coded icon.
- Cleaner **header/path bar**, folder **breadcrumb**, tab icons.
- Renamed to **Lumeed Document Inventory** with the official logo.

### Performance
- ~3× faster local scans and a shared in-session **page-count cache** (re-scanning the same folder is near-instant).

### Fixes
- **All summary cards show by default.** A one-time settings migration turns the optional cards back on for existing installs; user choices afterwards are kept.
- **Theme change no longer resets other settings** (it previously overwrote the whole settings file with defaults).
- **Cancel** stops the scan, keeps partial results, and shows the cancelled banner.
- **No crash when copying paths** (WinRT clipboard with a Win32 fallback).

### Install
Download **`Lumeed-Pcount-Setup-1.2.5-x64.exe`** below and run it. Running it over an older install upgrades in place — no need to uninstall first.

### Notes
- Requires Windows 10 version 1809 (x64) or later. Windows App Runtime 2.4 is bundled.
- Isolated duplicates (Settings → Isolate duplicates) can be reverted.

releases.name: Lumeed Pcount v1.2.3
releases.changelog:
## Lumeed Pcount v1.2.3

Speed improvements plus a cleaner duplicate workflow.

### Performance
- **~3× faster local scans.** Page counting now runs with `ProcessorCount × 2` parallel readers (measured **4,729 → 15,547 files/s** on a 16-core benchmark with small PDFs).
- Race-free progress counter (atomic increments).
- Removed a redundant per-file `stat` — the file size now comes from the same open used for the page count.

### Duplicates
- **Duplicate Files** now counts only the **extra copies** (one original is kept per group), e.g. two pairs of 2 report **2**, not 4.
- New **Duplicate Pages** card (its own toggle in Settings) = pages of the duplicate copies only.
- Each grouped row has one **“Copy Paths”** button that copies **every path in the group** — original and duplicates — one per line.
- Original / Duplicate tags are plain labels; the file list auto-sizes so nothing is clipped.

### Fixes
- **No more crash when copying paths** — clipboard now uses a crash-safe path (WinRT with a Win32 `CF_UNICODETEXT` fallback) and never throws.

### Install
Download **`Lumeed-Pcount-Setup-1.2.3-x64.exe`** below and run it.

### Notes
- Requires Windows 10 version 1809 (x64) or later. Windows App Runtime 2.4 is bundled.
- “Isolate duplicates” (Settings) moves extras into `<folder>\duplicates\...` and can be reverted.
- Duplicate matching = same **filename + page count + file size**.

releases.name: Lumeed Pcount v1.2.1
releases.changelog:
## Lumeed Pcount v1.2.1

Settings tab, duplicate isolation (with revert), and a working cancel button.

### What's new
- **Settings tab** — the app now has **Scan** and **Settings** tabs.
  - Theme picker moved to Settings (System / Light / Dark).
  - Toggles to show/hide the **Duplicate Files** and **Unique Pages** cards.
  - Auto re-scan toggle for isolate/revert.
- **Cancel/Stop now works** — clicking Cancel stops the scan, keeps the partial results, and shows the "Scan cancelled — results are partial" banner.
- **Isolate duplicates** — moves the extra copies of identical PDFs into a `duplicates` folder that mirrors your folder structure, **keeping one original per group**. Collisions get ` (1)`, ` (2)`… suffixes; failures are reported.
- **Revert isolation** — moves every isolated file back to its original folder using the manifest (`duplicates\_isolate-manifest.json`).
- **Better duplicate matching** — duplicates now require the same **filename + page count + file size** (fewer false positives).
- **Light-theme fix** — the minimize / maximize / close buttons are now visible in the Light theme.

### Install
Download **`Lumeed-Pcount-Setup-1.2.1-x64.exe`** below and run it.

### Notes
- Requires Windows 10 version 1809 (x64) or later. The Windows App Runtime 2.4 is bundled.
- Isolation moves files — it is **not** a copy. Use **Revert isolation** to undo.
- The `duplicates` folder is excluded from future scans so isolated copies are never re-flagged.

### Internals
- `DuplicateIsolator` (Core) performs the moves and keeps a JSON manifest for revert.
- `DuplicateDetector` groups by name + page count + size.
- Cancellation is now detected in the scanner loop and surfaced to the UI with partial results.

releases.name: Lumeed Pcount v1.2.0
releases.changelog:
## Lumeed Pcount v1.2.0

Theme support and large-scale scan hardening.

### What's new
- **Theme support** — a System / Light / Dark picker in the top bar. The choice is remembered between launches (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\LumeedPcount\settings.json`).
- **Large-scale scan hardening** — reliably scans **300,000+ PDF files**. A single unreadable folder can no longer abort the whole scan; each folder is enumerated in isolation and failures are reported.
- **Cycle-safe traversal** — junctions/symlinks can no longer cause an infinite traversal on complex or network storage. Reparse-point directories are skipped and reported (shown in "Errors / Skipped") so nothing is silently double-counted.
- **Correct deep-folder counts** — file, page, duplicate, and unique-page totals now roll up correctly at any folder nesting depth.
- **64-bit only** — x64 and ARM64 (x86 dropped).
- **Faster UI on huge trees** — the folder tree now loads collapsed and expands on demand, and the expensive periodic tree rebuild was removed.

### Install
Download **`Lumeed-Pcount-Setup-1.2.0-x64.exe`** below and run it.

### Notes
- Requires Windows 10 version 1809 (x64) or later. The Windows App Runtime 2.4 is bundled with the installer.
- Duplicate detection is unchanged: two files are duplicates when they share the same filename (case-insensitive) and page count. Unique pages count each distinct (name, page count) once.
- Junctions/symlinks are intentionally skipped to guarantee termination; their folders appear under "Errors / Skipped".

### Internals
- `FolderScanner` now enumerates via a materialized `IDirectoryLister` inside the guarded region, walks with a visited set, and fails closed when a directory's attributes cannot be read.
- Folder counters widened to `long`.

releases.name: Page Counter v1.0.0
releases.changelog:
### Features
- Recursive folder scan of local drives, mapped drives and UNC network paths.
- Exact PDF page counting via PdfPig (no full document parse into memory).
- Duplicate detection by content hash, with unique vs. total page totals reported separately.
- Per-folder breakdown in a navigable tree view.
- Skipped-folder and per-file error reporting instead of silent failures.
- Cancellable scan with live progress.

### Stack
- .NET 8, WinUI 3 (Windows App SDK 2.4), self-contained x64 publish.
- PdfPig for page extraction, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, xUnit test suite.

### System Requirements
- Windows 10 1809 (build 17763) or later, 64-bit.
- Administrator rights for installation.

### Install
Download `Lumeed-Pcount-Setup-1.0.0-x64.exe` and run it. The installer bundles the
.NET 8 runtime; it verifies the Windows App Runtime and redirects to the Microsoft
Store bootstrapper if it is missing.

Unsigned executable: on first launch Windows SmartScreen may prompt - click
**More info** then **Run anyway**.
